sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).

2. This is the 2nd successive bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Joda P.S. Case No.276 of 2022 corresponding to Special Case No.405 of 2022 pending in the file of learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Judge (POCSO), Keonjhar, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.450/342/376-AB/376(2)(f)/506 IPC r/w. Sec. 6 of POCSO Act, on the allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about less than 12 years by trespassing into her house and confining the victim.

3. Heard, Mr. Ramakrishna Naik, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. A. Pradhan, learned Addl. PP in the matter and perused the record, but none appears for the victim despite being duly informed as intimated by the learned counsel for the State.
4. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis-- vis the allegation sought to be brought against him and on going through the materials placed on record together with the evidence of the witnesses, more particularly that of the victim, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner stands rejected.
